title: KubeCon 2026 travel admin scratchpad
content:
Quick notes / purpose:
- master scratchpad for travel reimbursements, logistics, and vendor contacts for KubeCon North America 2026 (May 12-15).
- primary owner: Emma Li (events). Use this to collect receipts, vendor touchpoints, and last-minute checklists.

Important dates: 
- Conference: 2026-05-12 to 2026-05-15
- Booth ship arrives: target window 2026-05-10 to 2026-05-11 (see shipping ticket ENG-5421)
- Pre-event team meeting: 2026-05-09 10:00am PT (Zoom link in Slack thread)

Travel / bookings (team):
- Emma Li: SFO -> LV (UA 359) depart 2026-05-11 07:00, return UA 640 2026-05-16 18:00 (booked via corporate Concur)
- Jordan Kim: SFO -> LV (DL 784) depart 2026-05-11 08:30, return 2026-05-16 evening (pending)
- Samantha Lee: LAX -> LV depart 2026-05-11 11:00 (booked)
- Note: double-check seat upgrades and luggage fees before travel; receipts required for reimbursement.

Hotel:
- Mandalay Bay (group block under Redwood Inference)
- Check-in 2026-05-11, check-out 2026-05-16
- Rooming list: Jordan/Kyle double; Emma solo; Samantha + guest. Add final list to Concur profile.
- Parking/shuttle: Mandalay Bay charges daily valet; recommend Uber for team to minimize parking receipts.

Expense reminders (must include with expense report):
1) Flights: e-ticket + proof of payment (Concur/credit card statement).
2) Hotel: folio showing nightly rate + taxes, any incidentals must have itemized receipts.
3) Meals: follow per-diem/meal caps (US domestic rules) — tag items > $75 for review.
4) Ground transport: rideshare receipts (export from app) or shuttle invoices.
5) Booth-related expenses (ship, drayage, AV): vendor invoice + payment receipt + shipping tracking numbers.
6) Promotional items: invoice + proof of delivery (PO or packing list).
7) Any personal charges removed from folio with hotel credit note.

Reimbursement tips:
- Submit within 7 business days after travel to avoid delays.
- Put all receipts in one Concur report labeled "KubeCon2026 - TeamName".
- For any vendor pre-payments by card, attach email confirmation or purchase order.
- If paying cash for taxis, include date/time and a short note describing route and business purpose.

Vendor contacts (primary):
- Freeman (booth drayage + install):
  - Contact: Marco Diaz (Account Manager)
  - Phone: +1 702-555-0143
  - Email: marco.diaz@freeman.com
  - Notes: shipping label format needed by 2026-05-02. Ask for earliest install window.
- AVWorks (AV rental & onsite tech):
  - Contact: Priya Suresh (Sales)
  - Phone: +1 702-555-0188
  - Email: priya@avworks.com
  - Notes: confirm HDMI adaptors and spare lapel mic (we need 2).
- Badge & printing (OnsitePrintCo):
  - Contact: Javier Morales
  - Phone: +1 702-555-0222
  - Email: javier@onsiteprintco.com
  - Notes: final attendee list due 2026-05-04; print 200 flyers and 50 one-pagers.
- Local logistics (hotel logistics/shipping agent):
  - Contact: Sarah Nguyen (Mandalay Bay events liaison)
  - Phone: +1 702-555-0300
  - Email: s.nguyen@mandalay.com
  - Notes: confirm loading dock schedule and any forklift needs.
- Promo swag vendor: RedThread Promo
  - Contact: Ben Carter
  - Phone: +1 415-555-0107
  - Email: ben@redthreadpromo.com
  - Notes: shirts and stickers. Order was placed 2026-04-05; tracking number on file (attach invoice).

Onsite checklist (pre-travel):
- [ ] Finalize rooming list and share with People Ops by 2026-04-25
- [ ] Submit travel expenses for any pre-paid vendor invoices
- [ ] Confirm AV package and spare adapters with Priya (AVWorks) by 2026-04-28
- [ ] Send final attendee list to Javier (OnsitePrintCo) by 2026-05-04
- [ ] Upload all receipts to Concur and mark for team approval
- [ ] Pack emergency kit: power strips, USB-C adaptors, gaffer tape, zip ties, sharpsie, extra business cards

Booth shipping notes:
- Ship to Freeman advance warehouse (address in Confluence page).
- Labels must include company name, booth number, and contact phone (Emma Li +1 415-555-0199).
- Keep tracking numbers in the shipping spreadsheet (linked in Confluence).

Open questions / follow-ups:
- Does finance need pre-approval for promotional item spend > $2k? (Jordan to confirm with Finance 2026-02-17)
- Who is bringing the Mac mini for the demo? (Kyle volunteered but need to confirm serial# and backup)
- Confirm per-diem caps for international contractors joining from APAC (ask People Ops).

Notes to self / messy thoughts:
- If someone loses a receipt, try to get credit card statement + signed memo explaining expense.
- Consider prepaid Lyft credits for quick local transport for team leads.
- Keep a printed folder at the booth with emergency contacts + copies of invoices.

Quick links / tickets:
- Shipping ticket: ENG-5421
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.internal/display/EVENTS/KubeCon+2026+Booth
- Slack thread: https://redwood.slack.com/archives/C02EVENTS/p1675300000000

End of scratchpad.
